claim_summary: For the explicit one-coordinate orientation-exchange Metropolis pair kernel on the n=6, k=3 hard-BCS paired-basis sector, F=P_cycle+epsilon P_reverse has an irreducible positive support but a mode cut of conductance (epsilon^2+epsilon^4)/(3(1+epsilon^3)^2). The additive pair-energy witness forces L=(3+o(1))epsilon^-2, exponential in the O(log(1/epsilon))-bit input length. This does not refute richer worm kernels or general determinant-parity sampling.
